materiality.rationale: SWE-RPG combines executable patch evaluation with validated requirement and planning references across 163 tasks from 31 repositories and identifies implicit-requirement recovery as a bottleneck; it matters as a concrete evaluation of clarification and planning, with the benchmark findings remaining author-reported.

profile_annotations.why_this_issue: This candidate gives the Weekly issue a coding-agent benchmark that tests requirements and planning, not only final patches, so the implicit-requirement bottleneck can inform coverage of agent reliability.
